limitations.name: Urban-centric viewpoint
limitations.description: The report consistently frames insights around “consumidores urbanos/modernos”, so behaviours and expectations outside densely populated, highly connected cities may be under-represented.
limitations.mitigation: Complement with studies that sample rural and peri-urban populations in multiple regions.

limitations.name: Narrow sector scope
limitations.description: Findings target FMCG, consumer durables and consumer services; B2B industries, heavy manufacturing, public sector and informal economies receive little or no coverage.
limitations.mitigation: Cross-check with sector-specific analyses for industries not covered.

limitations.name: Short time horizon
limitations.description: Projections focus on the run-up to 2026; rapidly changing macro-economic or technological shocks beyond that window could invalidate trends.
limitations.mitigation: Update evidence annually and scenario-plan for longer horizons (5-10 years).

limitations.name: Qualitative bias
limitations.description: Narratives rely on illustrative cases and expert opinion; quantitative data or methodological details behind the ‘analysis’ are rarely disclosed, limiting reproducibility.
limitations.mitigation: Seek supporting datasets or peer-reviewed studies that quantify the magnitude of each cited trend.

limitations.name: Potential publisher bias
limitations.description: The document is produced by consulting firm Allegro 234, whose commercial interests may influence topic selection or tone.
limitations.mitigation: Compare with independent academic or governmental sources to validate key claims.
